title: Morning and Evening Adhkar - Hasbunallah
arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
latin: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul 'arsyil 'azhim
translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. On Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne. (7x morning & evening)
lesson: Seven times in morning and evening, Allah will suffice you. A shield.
